## Goal
Per CP-14: /developers/ still frames v0.2 as unreleased. v0.2.0 is published (GitHub release, PyPI 0.2.0). Use docs/marketing/release-notes-v0.2.0.md as the checked list of what shipped. Remove pre-release framing only for verified shipped items; keep unshipped items marked as planned. The GHCR image is NOT public yet: don't present docker pull as working without a GitHub login. Copy only, plain words.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- New tests are offline and deterministic (fake values only), no new dependencies.
- Relevant builds/checks pass (pnpm build, pnpm check, content_check, tests/test_web_*.py); existing tests stay green; ruff clean.
- Report product defects you find; don't fix files outside the allowed paths.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- web/src/pages/developers/index.astro
- tests/test_web_developer_release_status.py
- VENDOR_STATUS.md
- tests/test_web_developer_first_run.py (ONLY `test_examples_remain_coming`, lines 74-77: replace the superseded v0.2 pre-release assertions; touch nothing else in that file)

## Out of scope / do not touch
Everything else, especially shared components, CSP/build config, dependencies, wizard source code, and release data.

Report in docs/vendor/CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md when done.
